name: insertion-order
title: Insertion order working paper
for_each: select id,code from campaigns order by code

sections.title: Order terms
sections.note: Internal working paper. Review against the signed order and source reports before sharing.

sections.title: Placements
sections.sql: select p.code,p.name,u.name publication,p.start_on,p.end_on,p.goal,c.currency,p.fee_cents,p.creative_reference from placements p join publications u on u.id=p.publication_id join campaigns c on c.id=p.campaign_id where p.campaign_id=$1 order by p.code
sections.note: Internal working paper. Review against the signed order and source reports before sharing.

name: delivery-statement
title: Delivery statement
for_each: select id,code from campaigns order by code

sections.title: Delivery against order
sections.sql: select v.* from placement_pacing v join placements p on p.id=v.id where p.campaign_id=$1 order by v.code
sections.note: Internal working paper. Review against the signed order and source reports before sharing.

sections.title: Daily source evidence
sections.sql: select p.code,d.delivered_on,d.impressions,d.reference,d.evidence from deliveries d join placements p on p.id=d.placement_id where p.campaign_id=$1 order by d.delivered_on
sections.note: Internal working paper. Review against the signed order and source reports before sharing.

name: makegood-plan
title: Makegood working paper
for_each: select id,code from campaigns order by code

sections.title: Agreed replacement impressions
sections.sql: select m.code,p.code placement,m.units,m.due_on,m.owner,m.acceptance_reference,m.status,m.completed_on,m.evidence from makegoods m join placements p on p.id=m.placement_id where p.campaign_id=$1 order by m.code
sections.note: Internal working paper. Review against the signed order and source reports before sharing.
